key.name: joplin-url
key.description: Base URL of the Joplin Web Clipper service.

key.name: joplin-token
key.description: Token for the Joplin Data API. Found in Joplin under Tools › Options › Web Clipper › Advanced options.

key.name: notebook-id
key.description: ID of the notebook whose to-dos are shown. When empty, a top-level notebook called “Todos” is used, and created if needed.

key.name: show-count
key.summary: Show the number of open to-dos in the top bar
